messages:
maria: Quick coordination - we need to cut the annotated tag and push the draft GH release for v1.12.0-rc1 before EOD PST. Can someone take the tag + checksum step? I will handle the changelog sweep and release notes.

tom: I can do the tag. Do we have final artifact uploads in the staging bucket? link: s3://redwood-release/staging/v1.12.0-rc1

deploy-bot: Artifact upload finished: 3 files (runtime.tar.gz, wheels.zip, sbom.json). CI run 1245 ✅

sasha: quick check — is SBOM included in the release assets? need it for the compliance checklist.

maria: yes SBOM is there (sbom.json). Also added checklist in the draft notes: "SBOM, changelog, upgrade notes, breaking changes section". Jamie can you proof the upgrade note later?

jamie: on it, will glance in 30m. ping me @jamie if I miss it.

tom: prepping annotated tag locally. plan:
```bash
git tag -a v1.12.0-rc1 -m "v1.12.0-rc1: release candidate"
git push origin v1.12.0-rc1
```
Will run checksum digest after push and paste here.

oliver: CI bot will verify release artifacts post-tag. Heads up: if checksums mismatch, we'll hold publish.

ci-bot: checksum job queued (job #980). Will post results here when complete.

tom: pushed tag and created annotated message. checksum (sha256): 9f2c...a3b7

ci-bot: checksum job #980 passed. checksums match, signatures OK.

release-coordinator: Thanks - next step: create a Draft GitHub Release, attach the three artifacts, paste the changelog as the body, set pre-release. Tagger should mark the release as draft (do not publish until PM signoff).

maria: PR for changelog is merged. Draft notes added under the release body. @jamie once you ack I will publish (or we can wait for PM). :thumbsup:

jamie: LGTM. small wording nits fixed in the draft body.

maria: publishing in 10. will wait 5 for any last-second objections.

tom: all good from my side. :shipit:

maria: Published draft release (pre-release) and attached assets. Link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/releases/tag/v1.12.0-rc1

release-coordinator: Noted. PM asked to hold final GA publish until Monday morning for marketing alignment. Keeping this as pre-release is correct.

sasha: added a note in the incident sheet to mirror the SBOM path for archives.

maria: awesome, thanks all. closing loop. If anyone needs the final GA checklist, I'll post in the release doc tomorrow.
